_comment: Component inventory for the OPC UA Local Discovery Server INSTALLER.
This manifest declares only what THIS repository produces and links.
Components belonging to the submodules are declared by the submodules
themselves and composed in at generation time - see 'subprojects' below.
Do not restate them here; a component listed twice is a component that
will eventually disagree with itself.
Each subproject is a public GitHub repository that publishes its own
SBOM. New-Sbom.ps1 renders one BOM per subproject plus a composed BOM for
the installed product, which merges them and links back to each.
RULE: adding or bumping any shipped component requires updating the
manifest of whichever project owns it, in the same pull request.
See docs/cra/cybersecurity-policy.md section 2.4.
versionFrom.kind:
literal   - use the 'version' field as written
product   - the build version from version.txt + build.txt
project   - this manifest's project.versionFrom (for a project's own artifacts)
parameter - supplied by New-Sbom.ps1 (e.g. the MSVC toolset version)
header    - read #define macros out of a C header and join with '.',
so a component versioned in source is never restated here
Paths in versionFrom.path and shaFrom are relative to the PROJECT ROOT of
the manifest that declares them, so each manifest stands alone.
purl/cpe may contain {version} and {sha} placeholders.
cveMonitoring 'manual' means no usable CPE exists and the component must
be reviewed by hand against upstream release notes.
exposure records how an attacker reaches the component, which bounds the
severity of any advisory against it. Emitted as the cra:exposure property
so downstream consumers get the reachability context with the inventory:
network-facing    - listens on a socket; directly reachable
network-reachable - no listener, but processes network-origin data
install-time      - only runs during installation
local-only        - requires pre-existing local execution with rights

project.name: OPC UA Local Discovery Server
project.description: OPC UA Local Discovery Server for Windows - installer and companion tools.

components.name: ldsca.dll
components.notes: MSI custom actions: INI migration and PKI store initialisation. Runs only during installation, inside the already-elevated custom-action context. Built from CustomActions/ in this repository.

components.name: Opc.Ua.CertificateGenerator.exe
components.notes: NOT NETWORK-FACING. A command-line utility, invoked locally and only runnable by a program already executing on the machine. Versioned as its own product, independently of the LDS; the version is read from CertificateGenerator/src/version.h at generation time, which also feeds the binary's VERSIONINFO resource, so the two cannot drift.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.notes: Built from upstream tag openssl-3.5.7 by this repository's build.ps1 and linked statically ('no-shared no-asm no-autoload-config'), so a fix requires us to rebuild and re-release. 'no-ec' was REMOVED on 2026-10-05 to support the OPC UA ECC SecurityPolicies, so EC, ECDH, ECDSA and ECX are now compiled in and elliptic-curve advisories DO apply where they previously did not. The same install is consumed by the LDS submodule, which declares it in its own manifest; composition deduplicates the two entries on purl.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library

licenses.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library - proprietary, redistributable

components.notes: Linked into every shipped binary, including the two network-facing ones. STATICALLY LINKED via /MT (cmake/Hardening.cmake). Consequence: a CRT vulnerability is NOT remediated by Windows Update on the operator's machine - it requires us to rebuild and re-release.
